'''
Refactoring type: Move Method
Refactoring new name: N/A
'''
package memory
import "fmt"
type alloc struct {
opts map[int]int
}
func helper(a *alloc, memoryType int) bool {
return a.opts(memoryType) == 0
}
func (a *alloc) Calc() {
memoryType := 0
if helper(a, memoryType) { // move helper method into alloc receiver
fmt.Println("done")
}
}
// Bad moved result generated by refactoring engine
func (a *alloc) helper(Type int) bool {
return a.opts(memoryType) == 0
}
// Expected correct moved result
func (a *alloc) helper(memoryType int) bool {
return a.opts(memoryType) == 0
}
